best_idea: A server-side windowed speed check against the server's own run speed, with a log-only tier and a hard tier, that judges pending movement before an engine-granted exemption is switched on.
decision_why: Keep the windowed average, the two tiers and the flush-before-exempt order, but Frankendom's server moves the hero from client intent, so the check clamps the server's own motion as a sanity net; the donor trusts and then flags a client-reported position, which our server-authoritative rule rejects.
acceptance: A server test feeds one client 2.5 s of intent at 1.6 x run speed and asserts one warp ledger entry and that the stored position advances no more than run speed x window; at 1.2 x it asserts one light-warp entry and no position change beyond the clamp.
